fichas.h1: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano
fichas.h1_regla: opción más buscada: 'marble coffee table' (33100/mes); la descripción cubre las opciones: marble, wood
fichas.descripcion:
The Rock is a Rugiano coffee table with two bronzed brass legs and a top in marble or in decorated painted wood. Designed by Rugiano. Made in Italy.

TOP OPTIONS

  • Marble table. The top is available in a wide range of marble options.
  • Wood table. The top is in Decoro decorated painted wood.

LEGS AND SIZES

Both versions share the same two bronzed brass legs and come in two sizes. Check the size against your sofa before you choose the top; browse our coffee tables to compare shapes and tops.
fichas.descripcion_original: The Italian Rock coffee table features a stylish shaped top available in Decoro decorated painted wood or in a wide range of marble options. This versatile low table, available in two different sizes, has two refined legs made of bronzed brass metal. An innovative and functional coffee table to complement sophisticated sofas. Designed by Rugiano. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: La descripción respeta la ficha: dos patas de latón bronceado, tapa en mármol o en madera pintada decorada Decoro, dos tamaños, diseñada por Rugiano y fabricada en Italia. No hay datos inventados ni contradicciones; las keywords (rugiano coffee table, marble table, wood table) aparecen de forma natural en la frase y en las etiquetas de las opciones, y el tono es directo, sin relleno.

fichas.descripcion:
The Club is a Rugiano sofa built on a structure of brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes. In this club style sofa, the metal pattern is combined with upholstery in leather or fabric. Made in Italy.

FRAME AND UPHOLSTERY

  • Structure in brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes.
  • Upholstery in leather or in fabric.

The tubes stay visible next to the covering, so the combination is what gives this club couch its pattern. Order the metal finish and the upholstery as one decision: both are always part of the final look.

See the rest of our sofas and sectionals.
fichas.descripcion_original: This is a designer Italian Sofa, part of the exclusive Club collection. It stands out for the innovative structure created by refined brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes that, combined with the upholstered leather or fabric, create a stylish pattern. A high-end Glamour furniture, ideal to fit in any sophisticated living area.Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: La descripción se atiene a la ficha: estructura de tubos de latón/bronce cepillado o dibujado, tapizado en cuero o tela, patrón por combinación y Made in Italy (la ficha lo dice). Las keywords (rugiano sofa, club style sofa, club couch) aparecen integradas en oraciones con sentido propio, sin contradicciones ni datos inventados; el H1 lo fija el equipo SEO y la descripción es coherente con él.

fichas.h1: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion:
The Hermes Maxi is an upholstered king bed by DV Home Collection. This Hermes bed has a multilayer structure covered with non-deformable polyurethane foam and a large headboard with vertical quilting. The Maxi bed is made in Italy.

UPHOLSTERY OPTIONS

  • Fabric: a wide range of fabric options over the padded structure.
  • Leather: a wide range of leather options over the same padded structure.

Both cover the same padded structure, so choose the upholstery you prefer.

HEADBOARD AND CUSHIONS

Goose feather square decorative cushions are available on request. For a coordinated bedroom, see our king beds.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Part of the Italian Hermes collection, this double bed is offered with a multilayer structure covered with non-deformable polyurethane foam.

The upholstery is offered in a wide range of fabric or leather options and the large headboard features a refined vertical quilting. Also, to add more comfort, goose feather square decorative cushions (19”5/8 or 15”3/4) are available upon request.

Elegance and Glamour characterize this versatile Italian furniture piece. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Tiffany Multilayered Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection

The Tiffany style mirror by DV Home Collection has a multilayered structure and natural mirror glass in a metal frame. Made in Italy.

SIX FRAME FINISHES

  • Shining stainless steel
  • Antique bronze satin
  • Shaded glossy or shaded satin
  • Chrome black
  • 24Kt gold dipped

BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

The natural mirror glass and the layered build are identical in every version, so the choice is the finish. Tiffany mirrors come in six; pick one against your wall color and lighting.

Browse all wall mirrors at Cassoni.

The refined frame is offered in shining stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black or dipped in 24Kt gold. This luxury Italian piece will surely add a Glamour style to any interior space. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Illan Wood Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.descripcion:
The Illan lamp is a Luceplan wall sconce designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath. A die-cast aluminum body carries the LED; the shade is laser-cut, layered wood that sends a soft glow upward. Made in Italy.

WOOD SHADE

Each wood sconce is cut from surplus layered wood left over from making the Illan suspension lamp.

LED AND APPROVAL

The Luceplan Illan is dimmable and UL Approved. LED 21W, 1265lm, 2700K/3000K, CRI 90.

Its upward light suits a hallway or a bedside. See all wall sconces.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Illan wall lamp brings the poetic lightness and innovative spirit of Zsuzsanna Horvath’s design into a refined, space-saving format. This elegant wall light features a die-cast aluminum body housing an efficient LED source that casts a soft, warm glow upward, enriching interiors with atmospheric, eco-friendly illumination. Its distinctive shade is crafted from laser-cut, layered wood, an ultra-thin and flexible material that defines Illan’s iconic geometric silhouette. In a commitment to sustainable design, the wooden element is made from surplus material left over from producing the Illan suspension lamp, transforming production scraps into a sculptural, decorative feature.

Lightweight, contemporary, and environmentally conscious, the Illan wall lamp is a perfect choice for those seeking designer wall lighting, warm LED ambience, and Italian craftsmanship that merges technology, beauty, and sustainability. UL Approved (Product build according to the National Electrical Code’s requirements and tested by Underwriters Laboratories). Made in Italy.

Light source: LED 21W 1265lm 2700K/3000K CRI 90 Dimmable. UL Approved.

fichas.descripcion:
The Shibari is a Visionnaire armchair with a continuous, enveloping silhouette, fully covered in stretch fabric. Its curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest in a fluid knot.

THE KNOT

That knot is the structure, not an ornament: on this Visionnaire chair the metal legs run up the back and join, so frame and form are one element.

SEAT AND COMFORT

The fabric armchair uses a high-density polyurethane core and a webbed seat for support.

If the knot matters as much as the seat, compare it with other chairs and armchairs.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Shibari chair comes fully covered in stretch fabric, featuring a continuous and enveloping silhouette. The curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest, forming a fluid knot that merges structure and formal expression. The high-density polyurethane core and webbed seat ensure comfort and support, striking a balance between visual lightness and structural solidity.

Across history the knot has had many different meanings, including sacred and religious symbolism. In Egypt it represented life: the knot of Isis stood for immortality and divine love. The endless knot is one of the most ancient figures utilized in Buddhist symbolism in China and Tibet, but also in geographically distant zones, to convey a sense of infinite devotion. Tying and knotting mean joining, connecting two objects, bringing them together in harmonious progress. Since ancient times the knot has had a clear meaning of junction and commitment between two people. This meaning is immediately associated with love, precisely to emphasize the inseparable nature of a bond.

This symbol conveys meanings of eternity and faithfulness. A knot made properly will not come undone, opening and separating the two objects it holds fast. Therefore a love knot unites two people forever. It is not a noose, not a tight restraint, but an intertwined connection, representing a sense of give and take, of help in moments of need. It is a soft knot that links without duress. Extended horizontally, it reminds us of the symbol of infinity: what could be a better way to represent everlasting love?

omitidas.motivo: La ficha describe una sola armchair y no menciona una familia de piezas Shibari; usar 'Shibari furniture' obligaría a inventar una categoría de producto que la ficha no respalda.

validacion.razon: El H1 identifica correctamente el producto (armchair de tela de Visionnaire) y la descripción se limita a los datos de la ficha: funda de stretch fabric, patas tubulares metálicas curvas que convergen en el respaldo formando un nudo, y núcleo de poliuretano de alta densidad con asiento de cinchas. No hay datos inventados, contradicciones ni keywords usadas fuera de sentido; el tono es descriptivo y sin relleno.
